translation: Kwabantwana baYoabhi, kuvela u-Obhadhya unyana kaYekhiyeli, kunye naye amadoda amakhulu angamakhulu amabini anamashumi alinesibhozo; onke la ngamakhosikazi akhaliphileyo akwalwa ngesibini—hayi, nguMashumi amabini anesibhozo: amadoda alo ilishumi elinesine; onke amadoda la engamakhulu angama-317; uNoadiya ilishumi elinesibini nakunye nesixhenke sakhe: ukutsho kokutsha kukhululekileyo; amadoda engama-320; yonke into ihambele kakuhle ekhaya, ngo-468.
